title: Controlplane team round-robin standup - 2026-06-24
content:
Meeting: Controlplane — round-robin standup (timeboxed 35m)
Date: 2026-06-24
Facilitator: Evelyn Chen
Attendees: Evelyn, Aisha, Miguel, Samir, Riley, Janet (partial)

1) Quick status (60s per person)
- Evelyn: landed auth key rotation dry-run in staging, starting canary rollout for the token cache fix (PR #924). Observed 2% error spike during first 1h window — investigating replay pressure.
- Aisha: routing fairness experiment (biased hashing -> latency-weighted routing) is green in canary; p99 improved from 210ms to 170ms for mixed workloads on ded-1. Need config toggles before broader rollout.
- Miguel: quota enforcement patch (PLAT-1187) merged to staging; tests show 12% reduction in quota-reserved overcommit. Still failing a race in burst path when autoscaler scales down.
- Samir: control plane GC tuning — reduced control-plane CPU by ~8% after lowering sweep frequency. Observed longer lease hold times for ephemeral queues; added metric to surface queue retention.
- Riley: rollout plan for region fallback policy drafted, awaiting approval from infra-sre. Draft adds per-tenant max-fallbacks/day and a soft-throttle to avoid cross-region blast radius.
- Janet: finishing SLI proposal for quotas (error budget burn attribution); will sync with SRE next week.

2) Deep-dive items and notes
A) Auth key rotation dry-run (Evelyn)
- What happened: dry-run rotated keys in staging for 2m active services. For 4% of requests we saw token validation latency regress ~35ms due to additional KMS calls.
- Root cause hypothesis: an intermittent cache miss path in the token verifier triggered synchronous KMS fetch.
- Immediate mitigation: enabled small LRU cache with longer TTL in verifier (staging) — reduced KMS calls by 90%.
- Action: Samir to add telemetry to verifier to capture cache-hit ratio and KMS latency by service (JIRA: PLAT-1210). Due: 2026-06-28.

B) Routing fairness experiment (Aisha)
- Experiment results: rollout on ded-pool A for 48h. Weighted routing algorithm reduced p99 for tail-heavy tenants. Mean latency unchanged.
- Concern: fairness metric impacts throughput for very short requests; need to set a min weight floor to avoid starving tiny requests.
- Action: Aisha will add a config flag to the routing policy to enforce min-weight and an operator toggle for the next canary. PR expected: 2026-06-26.

C) Quota enforcement races (Miguel)
- Symptoms: transient overcommit during scale-down: quota ledger subtract operation lost against concurrent allocation window. Repro in CI when autoscaler aggressiveness is set high.
- Temporary workaround: increase autoscaler cooldown to 60s for affected clusters.
- Longer term: move ledger ops into a single-threaded actor per-tenant (design doc under review).
- Action: Miguel to post actor-design doc and pair with Janet for SLI impact assessment. JIRA: PLAT-1187 follow-ups. Due: 2026-07-02.

3) Blockers and escalations
- Blocker: regulated-tenant fallback policy requires privacy review before enabling cross-region fallback. Riley to escalate to security-compliance.
- Blocker: flaky integration tests for PR #924 (token cache fix) caused 3 CI failures this week. Evelyn to triage with release-eng.

4) Operational metrics snapshot (this morning)
- Control-plane API p95: 98ms (baseline 95ms), p99: 210ms (baseline 200ms) — small tail drift during morning traffic surge.
- Quota violation rate (last 24h): 0.23% (target <0.5%).
- Auth KMS calls per 1k requests: 6.8 -> after patch 0.6 (staging).
- Routing rollout traffic: 8% of ded-pool A currently on weighted routing experiment.

5) Decisions made
- Approve canary progress for routing fairness to increase to 25% of ded-pool A contingent on min-weight floor (Aisha to implement).
- Hold cross-region fallback for regulated-tenants until security sign-off. Riley to follow up by EOD 2026-06-25.

6) Action items (owner — due date)
- Samir: add verifier telemetry (cache-hit, kms-latency) and dashboard. Due 2026-06-28.
- Aisha: implement min-weight floor flag + operator toggle; open canary-runbook update. Due 2026-06-26.
- Miguel: publish actor-design doc for quota ledger and schedule design review with Janet. Due 2026-07-02.
- Evelyn: triage flaky CI for PR #924 with release-eng, file infra ticket if needed. Due 2026-06-27.
- Riley: escalate regulated-tenant fallback to security-compliance and capture sign-off or blocking concerns. Due 2026-06-25.
- Janet: draft SLI mapping for quotas and share with SRE for review. Due 2026-06-30.

7) Notes to self / loose threads
- Consider a short-lived feature-flagged path to bypass KMS for internal tenants during rotation windows (security ok?). Ping security for guidance.
- Need to add per-tenant routing diagnostic traces to help debug tail latency anomalies — follow-up in next weekly infra sync.
- Track canary rollback budget explicitly in rollout playbook (how many percent and error rate threshold).

8) Next meeting and cadence
- Next round-robin standup: 2026-07-01 (same time). Proposal: add a 10-min adhoc slot every other meeting for live debugging  (vote: +3 / -1 / abstain 1).

9) Links referenced in meeting
- PLAT-1187: Quota enforcement backlog: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/PLAT-1187
- PLAT-1210: Auth verifier telemetry: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/PLAT-1210
- PR 924: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/924
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/PLT/Control+Plane+Runbook

End notes: handwritten-style quick items included (rough timings noted). This doc is intentionally informal — will copy/paste critical decisions into Confluence after follow-ups are confirmed.
